messages:
tess_sales: Heads up 3> buyer asks for a minimal artifact pack to sign POC acceptance by EOD Fri. They also want to know if we can provide a temporary attestation for SOC gaps and whether full pen-test report is available.

ryan_ps: Minimal pack we send: SOC2 Type II attestation or signed controls summary, pen-test attestation (signed) or redacted exec summary, staging network diagram, SSO test account, staging IPs/VPN details, and POC support runbook. We can include a one-paragraph KMS/key custody note if they ask.

maya_security: We can issue a "temporary attestation" that notes current controls and a remediation plan for any non‑critical gaps, but legal usually wants a fixed window (30 days) and explicit scope. For pen-test: default = signed attestation + redacted summary. Full report requires NDA + dataroom + legal approval.

maya_security: If buyer needs vendor name or scan dates, we can provide those in the attestation but not raw logs.

cal_ops: Staging IPs for quick POC: example whitelist we give: 3.120.45.0/28 ingress, 3.120.45.16/30 callbacks. Static public IPs ok but ops needs 72 hours and it may change billing.

ryan_ps: On pricing: no dedicated commit required to run the POC. we can offer a short trial reservation for predictable latency; if they push for a month of static capacity we should quote it and note it affects availability SLAs.

tess_sales: Can someone turn this into a 1-page checklist? buyer's exact Q: "is network diag + SSO + pen-test attestation enough to sign?"

ryan_ps: Typical answer: yes—if attestation says no outstanding criticals and SSO is validated in staging. Suggested one-pager items:
- SOC2 Type II attestation OR signed controls summary
- Pen-test attestation OR redacted exec summary (statement of no open criticals + remediation ETA for any highs)
- UAT/staging network architecture diagram
- SSO/SAML test user validated in staging
- Staging IP whitelist or VPN details
- POC support hours & escalation contact

maya_security: I'll attach the pen-test attestation template and a proposed temporary attestation language. if they request full report, ask for CISO/legal email and reason.

cal_ops: Ping me for ops ticket if they want static IPs or a month reservation.

tess_sales: Thanks—i'll send the one-pager and capture legal/CISO. will loop you in if they push for full report or reserved pricing :thumbsup:
